annotations.text:
MAIN (left): the 50/50 split menu - each brand gets one half of the sheet, torn down the middle.

Item names and prices are sample copy - click any line to retype it. The [ADDRESS] / [INSTAGRAM] / [PHONE] slots in the footer are yours to fill.

B and C are rough alternates: one shared board, or stacked halves. Tell me which direction you like and I will build it out fully.

Four font directions for the brand, each shown as a real menu specimen.

A is what the menu uses today. D gives each brand its own voice - slab for Smash and Pass, hand-painted script for Dee's - tied together by one body face.

Tell me the letter you like and I will apply it across the whole menu. (Use the pages menu in the toolbar to flip back to the Menu page.)
